QuoteProvider.reason: Prices and splits from Yahoo Finance; the Yahoo adapter (#6) fills quotes, splits, dividends and assets.

DividendProvider.reason: Dividends from Yahoo Finance; the Yahoo adapter (#6) fills them with the quotes.

FundamentalsProvider.reason: Yearly fundamentals from StatusInvest; the adapter is built (#8), but the site blocks requests from this server, so loads fail with the block message (ADR 0010).

StatementProvider.reason: Financial statements from CVM ITR and DFP; built in the CVM statements issue.

FundDataProvider.reason: Monthly FII data from StatusInvest; the adapter is built (#8), but the site blocks requests from this server, so loads fail with the block message (ADR 0010).

FilingProvider.reason: Filing list from the CVM IPE file (#9); a load of a ticker fails with a named error until a source maps tickers to CNPJ.

DocumentProvider.reason: Document download and text for CVM and FNET filings; built in the document text issue.

MacroProvider.reason: Macro series from BCB SGS; the BCB adapter (#7) fills ipca, cdi, selic and ptax.
